limits: Four fixture scenarios exercise 68 explicit transition observations with the production observer/formatter and toolbar markup/CSS.
Actual document mouse input is verified before and after reload. Physical hybrid touch/pinch is not tested.
The pre-existing whole-farm resize refit is excluded from language-only camera checks; computed zoom poses verify fixed-viewport language changes.
Viewport application is awaited through responsive brand visibility and requested width checks.
No download, upload, clipboard, import or gameplay test. Farm export comparisons stay in memory.

cameraOracle.note: The existing whole-farm width-resize listener in cozy-world.js:46 intentionally refits overview. Verify language-only camera preservation at a fixed viewport using independently calculated zoom poses; last-input retention remains covered by all four layout checks.

viewportOracle.note: An initial viewport read preceded its responsive reflow. Final measurements await the responsive brand visibility and assert the requested innerWidth.
